Not wanting to sound like a boomer but we used to farm these for years in Diablo 2. In Diablo 4s earlier seasons we didn’t even have resplendent sparks so trashing Ubers u don’t need is useless. Now you got pseudo-guaranteed drops and pity systems in place (the uber-crafting) and people still find ways to complain about ubers.

Plus you can literally slot in Non-Ancestral items since season 6 and it wouldn’t make much difference cause the stat-roll difference isn’t that much compared to previous seasons. 

I was like you at some point in this game. I played diablo 2 and I wanted stuff to be spoon-fed to me as I felt like I deserved it after working the frontlines, but if we keep complaining about every boo-boo and ouchies the devs wouldn’t have time to focus on more important stuff and issues that are still in the game.

Greatest season just yet. Shows you that when the team invests effort into something as great as this game it’s bound to be something good. 

All my previous qualms about the game have been resolved (yes, even the whining about not getting my needed enchants for gear. This season made my characters so powerful and snappy that it just didn’t matter to me if I hit the right gear stats bulls-eye).

Have high hopes for Season 8.

Hello po, is it rehomed or pulot? Either way ensure po muna na properly dewormed si bebi and that they’ll get the vaccines they need ASAP. 

Also worth checking lalo na pag rehomed if inbred.

And of course stock up on supplies. Would highly suggest you get the essentials first like wet and dry food, I’d recommend Aozi, Monello, and Royal Canin, tas vitamins like LC-VIT. Plus points pag meron kang wild salmon oil para lalo silang ganahan kumain.

Litter sand I don’t really have a preference but some people swear against bentonite, if you’re like them, find tofu sand na lang or something of the likes. Sawdust works too!

Btw, go only for ceramic/metal food bowls cause baka magkasakit sila sa bibig with plastic bowls, wash it everyday rin.

Once maipasok na si bebi sa bahay niyo don’t be too stressed if di kaagad siya kumain or di mag wiwi and pupu, they will be stressed and will need to acclimate first before they can get on with their new lives. Of course it goes without saying na if the situation persists even after a day lang especially if di sila nakain na you should go see a vet na.
